description: The National Census of Ferry Operators (NCFO) of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics is a census of ferry operators in the United States, run in even years, whose responses describe operators, vessels, terminals and route segments for the preceding calendar year. Censuses released on the BTS data portal include 2016 (880 operator responses on 2015 operations, with revenue and public funding sources), 2018 (operators, vessels, terminals and segments for 2017), 2020, 2022 and 2024. The 2022 files list 670 vessels with capacity for passengers and vehicles, fuel type, speed, year built, horsepower, hull and propulsion, dimensions and tonnage, ownership and operation, and 914 segments linking terminal pairs, with a flag for segments serving National Park Service units. Coverage is national. The data are free and in the public domain on data.bts.gov, a Socrata portal with CSV and JSON export and an API. Caveats: data are self-reported by responding operators, some terminals and segments are reported by more than one operator, and variables differ between census years. The vessel and terminal inventories support hazard exposure and resilience analysis of ferry services, and the segment network supports network flow and capacity planning of marine highways. It is related to the National Transportation Atlas Database.
